description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Vayne's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] and ''[[File:Vayne Condemn.png|20xpx|border|link=Vayne#Condemn|An icon for Vayne's ability Condemn]] [[Vayne#Condemn|Condemn]]'' apply a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Silver Bolts'' for 3.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, expiring upon attacking a new enemy, and stacking up to 3 times.
description.text: Passive: Vayne's basic attacks on-hit and Condemn apply a stack of Silver Bolts for 3.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, expiring upon attacking a new enemy, and stacking up to 3 times.

description2.raw: The third stack consumes them all to deal [[File:Hybrid penetration icon.png|15px|link=True damage]] '''bonus''' true damage, with a minimum threshold.
description2.text: The third stack consumes them all to deal  bonus true damage, with a minimum threshold.

description3.raw: ''Silver Bolts'' deals modified damage against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description3.text: Silver Bolts deals modified damage against monsters.

leveling2.raw:
'''Bonus True Damage:'''
6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10% of target's '''maximum''' health
'''Minimum Bonus Damage:'''
50 / 65 / 80 / 95 / 110
leveling2.text:
Bonus True Damage:6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10% of target's maximum health
Minimum Bonus Damage:50 / 65 / 80 / 95 / 110

notes.raw: * [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|Stacks]] are not removed if '''Vayne''' switches to attacking a target immune to ''Silver Bolts'' ([[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]], [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|wards]]). * ''Silver Bolts'' do not apply to additional targets with [[File:Runaan's Hurricane item.png|20xpx|border|link=Runaan's Hurricane|An icon for the item Runaan's Hurricane]] [[Runaan's Hurricane]]. * The stacks can be consumed even if the target is in [[File:Stasis icon.png|20px|link=Types_of_Crowd_Control#Stasis|An icon representing the keyword Stasis]] [[:Types_of_Crowd_Control#Stasis|stasis]].
notes.text:
Stacks are not removed if Vayne switches to attacking a target immune to Silver Bolts ( structures, wards).
Silver Bolts do not apply to additional targets with Runaan's Hurricane.
The stacks can be consumed even if the target is in stasis.
